Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2010
ACT II OF 2010
BALOCHISTAN JUDICIAL ACADEMY
ACT, 2010
An Act to provide for the establishment of Judicial
Academy in the Province
of Balochistan
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th January, 2010]
No.PAB/Legis:V(2)/2010, dated 30-1-2010.---The Balochistan Judicial Bill, 2010 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 15th January,
2010 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan, on
25th January, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Whereas it is expedient
to establish an academy for imparting training to the Judicial Officers and
court personnel in order to improve their capacity, professional competency and
ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters
ancillary thereto:
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan
Judicial Academy Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Definitions

ACT II OF 2010

No.PAB/Legis:V(2)/2010, dated 30-1-2010.---The Balochistan Judicial Bill, 2010 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 15th January,
2010 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan, on
25th January, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Whereas it is expedient
to establish an academy for imparting training to the Judicial Officers and
court personnel in order to improve their capacity, professional competency and
ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters
ancillary thereto:
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in
the subject or context:
(a) "Academy"
means the Balochistan
Judicial Academy.
(b)
"Board" means the Board of Governors of the Academy.
(c) "Chairman"
means the Chairman of the Board.
(d)
"Vice-Chairman" means the Vice-Chairman of the Board.
(e) "Director
General" means the Director General of the Academy; appointed under
section 10.
(f)
"Director" means the Director of the Academy.
(g) "Government"
means the Government of the Balochistan;
(h) "Judicial
Officer" means a District and Sessions Judge, a Sadar/President
of Majlis-e-Shoora, a ? Presiding Officer of a Labour Court, an Additional District and Sessions Judge, a
Senior Civil Judge, a Member of Majlis-e-Shoora, a
Civil Judge, a Judicial Magistrate, a Special Judicial Magistrate, a Qazi, or a Presiding Officer of a court or a tribunal under
the administrative control of the High Court of Balochistan;
(i) "Member" means a member of the Board;
(j)
"Prescribed" means prescribed by the rules made under this Act; and
(k)
"Staff" means members of the staff of the
Academy, including contract employees, part time employees and employees on
deputation.

Establishment of the Academy

2010 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan, on
25th January, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Whereas it is expedient
to establish an academy for imparting training to the Judicial Officers and
court personnel in order to improve their capacity, professional competency and
ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters
ancillary thereto:
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
3. Establishment
of the Academy.---(1) The Government shall by Notification establish
an Academy to be called the Balochistan Judicial
Academy.
The Academy shall
be a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal with power to
acquire, hold and dispose of property both movable and immovable and shall by
the said name sue and be sued.
The headquarters of
the Academy shall be at Quetta.

Aims and Objects

2010 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan, on
25th January, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Whereas it is expedient
to establish an academy for imparting training to the Judicial Officers and
court personnel in order to improve their capacity, professional competency and
ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters
ancillary thereto:
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
4. Aims and
Objects.--The aims and objects of
the Academy shall be:
(a) orientation and training of new Judges. Magistrates,
Law Officers, Court Personnel, and any other person or group of persons.
(b) pre-service and in-service training and education of Judges,
Magistrates, Law Officers, Court Personnel;
(c) holding of conferences, seminars, workshops and symposia for
improvement of the judicial system and quality of judicial work; and
(d) publishing of books, journals, research papers, memories and
reports etc.

The Board of Governors

court personnel in order to improve their capacity, professional competency and
ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters

5. The Board of
Governors.---(1) The general
direction and administration of the Academy and its affairs shall vest in a
Board of Governors, which may exercise all powers and do all acts and things
relating there to and as envisaged hereunder in section 6.
(2) The Board of
Governors shall consist of the following:--
(i) The Chief Justice of Balochistan
High Court Chairman
(ii) The Senior Puisne Judge of Balochistan High
Court Vice-Chairman
(iii) The Registrar,
Balochistan High Court. Member
(iv)
The Secretary, Government of Balochistan Finance Departmen Member
(v) The District
and Sessions Judge, to be nominated by
the Chief Justice of Balochistan
High Court. Member
(vi)
The Secretary, Government of Balochistan, Law &
Parliamentary
Affairs Department Member
(vii) The Director
General Member/Secretary

Powers and functions of the Board

25th January, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Whereas it is expedient
to establish an academy for imparting training to the Judicial Officers and
court personnel in order to improve their capacity, professional competency and
ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters
ancillary thereto:
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
6. Powers and
functions of the Board:--For
carrying out the aims and objects of the Academy, the Board shall, inter alia:
(a) exercise general supervision over the affairs of the
Academy,
(b) lay down the policy, curriculum and program for training and
approve courses of the training;
(c) evaluate and examine the activities of the Academy;
(d) approve and consider the annual budget and revised budget
estimates of the Academy;
(e) receive grants-in-aid and donations from the Federal
Government. Provincial Government and aid giving agencies NGOs etc;
(f) cause proper books of accounts to be maintained for all sums
of money received and expended by the Academy and arrange for audit by the
Director-General Audit, of Balochistan;
(g) prescribe the terms and conditions of service of the
Director General/Director and members of the Staff;
(h) create, abolish, suspend and upgrade posts;
(i) prescribe duties of the members
of the staff;
(j) appoint, suspend, punish, dismiss or remove from service any
member of the staff;
(k)purchase, hire, construct or alter any building for the
Academy;
(1) hold, control and administer the moveable and immovable
property, assets and funds of the Academy;
(m) regulate, determine' and administer all matters
concerning the Academy;
(n) affiliate with Provincial judicial academies and the other
training and educational institutions; and
(o) decide any other matter ancillary and incidental to the aims
and objects of the Academy.

to establish an academy for imparting training to the Judicial Officers and
court personnel in order to improve their capacity, professional competency and
ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters

It is hereby
enacted as follows:
7. Delegation of
powers:---(1) The Board may
delegate all or any of its powers and functions under this Act or the Rules or
regulations to the Chairman, Vice-Chairman, (Senior Puisne
Judge) or any member of the Board, the Director General or any member of the staff.
(2) The
Director-General may, in any emergency which in his opinion requires immediate
action, exercise such powers as he may consider necessary in the circumstance,
and shall report the action taken by him for approval of the Board at its next
meeting.

8. Appointment
of advisers, consultants and experts:---The Board
may appoint advisers, consultants and experts for assisting the Board in
fulfillment of its aims and objects.

ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters

It is hereby

9. Meetings of
the Board:---(1) The meeting of the Board shall be called by the Chairman and in his
absence by Vice-Chairman (Senior Puisne Judge) on
such date, time and place as he may specify.
(2) Subject to subsection
(1) the intervening period between two meetings of the Board shall not exceed
six months.
(3) The Chairman or
in his absence, the Vice-Chairman, shall preside over the meeting of the Board.
(4) The Quorum for
the meeting of the Board shall be four members.
(5) The Board may,
from time to time, appoint such committees and working groups, from amongst
its members or otherwise, as it may consider necessary.

Whereas it is expedient
to establish an academy for imparting training to the Judicial Officers and
court personnel in order to improve their capacity, professional competency and
ethical standards for efficient dispensation of justice in courts and matters
ancillary thereto:
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
10.
Director-General.--(1) The
Director-General shall be appointed by the Chairman, on such terms and
conditions as may approve by the Board.
(2) The
Director-General shall be a person who has been a Judge of High Court or a
District and Sessions Judge, eligible to be appointed as Judge of High Court.
(3) The management
of the Academy shall be carried on by
the Director-General under the general directions of the Board.
(4) The
Director-General shall be the academic and administrative head of the Academy
and shall be responsible for the maintenance of good order and discipline.
(5) The
Director-General shall be the Principal Accounting Officer of the Academy.
(6) In absence of
the Director-General on account of any reason, the Board may depute a Senior
Director to act and perform all the functions of the Director General under
this Act.

25th January, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
Whereas it is expedient
to establish an academy for imparting training to the Judicial Officers and

11. Appointment
of officers and members of staff of the Academy.--(1) The appointment of officers and staff of the
Academy shall be made by direct recruitment or transfer, or deputation or on
contract basis in such manner and on such terms and conditions as may be
prescribed by the Board.
(2) All
appointments of the members of the staff to posts in basic Pay Scales 1 to 15
shall be made by the Director-General with prior approval of the Chairman.
(3) Appointment of
the members, of the staff to posts in Basic Pay Scale 16 and above shall be
made by the Chairman.

12. Funds of the
Academy.---(1) There shall be a
fund of the Academy to be known as the "Academy Fund" to which all
its income shall be credited and from which all its expenditures shall be met.
(2) The following shall
be the sources of income for the Academy Fund:
(i) Grants from the Federal
Government;
(ii)
Grants from the Provincial Government;
(iii) Sale and other proceeds
of the Academy's publications;
(iv)
Aid from national and
international agencies; and
(v) Fees, charges
and donations.
(3) The academy
Funds shall vest in the Board and the moneys to the credit of the Fund shall be
kept in a scheduled bank with the
approval of the Board.

financial year, submit for approval of the Board, by such date and in such form
as may be prescribed, a statement
showing the estimated receipts, the current and development expenditures and
the sums required as grant-in-aid from the Federal Government/Provincial
Government.
(2) The
Director-General shall not incur any expenditure from the Fund, which is not provided for in the
Budget approved by the Board:

Reports, etc.---(1) Within two months of the conclusion of each financial year, the
Director-General shall submit the annual report to the Board in respect of various activities carried out by the
academy during the previous year.
(2) The Board shall
publish an annual report.

15. Power to
make rules.---The Board may, with the prior approval of the
Government make rules and regulations for carrying out the purposes of this
Act. Such rules and regulations may provide for.--
(a) the powers and duties of the officers and staff of the
Academy;
(b) the terms and conditions of service of the officers and
employees of the Academy, including disciplinary action, grant of leave and
retirement of the officers and employees of the Academy;
(c) the constitution of pension or provident fund or both for
the' benefit of the officers and employees of the Academy; and
(d) such other matters as are required to be prescribed by rules
and regulations, for the smooth working of the academy under this Act.
